In the diamond business, it sets out expanding the scale of its polycrystalline diamond manufacturing and sales business through collaboration with its capital and business alliance partner and strengthening entry into the fixed abrasive market; in the quarrying business, expanding crushed stone supply by developing market needs in its supply areas and developing new sales areas; and in new businesses, it states that it will form a study team and advance preparations for launch. In the diamond business, it also lists making Trustwell Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary as a future initiative.
